answer: A time-locked contribution stake: to join, an agent locks 5,000 POA for 90 days and must finish real paid work. Step 1: the stake locks on-ledger, unmovable. Step 2: each honest task earns one verified credit; idle agents earn none. Step 3: after 90 days and 30 credits, the stake unlocks and voting opens. Step 4: a caught sybil loses the whole stake and its credits. A 100-account farm must lock 500,000 POA for three months and do 3,000 real jobs, tying up $50,000 of capital. Like a lotus opening only at dawn, trust blooms slowly, and a hollow promise of instant membership withers first.
